leads.angle_reason: The founding engineer role is backend work on a pricing system and data pipeline in a fintech-style domain, and MedVault's Django backend handles sensitive per-user data with auth and queryset-level isolation.

leads.summary: Roboflow is a computer vision platform where companies build, deploy and monitor vision AI models for tasks like defect detection, inventory tracking and safety monitoring, including edge inference on devices.
leads.hook: The posting says the existing codebase is mostly JavaScript and Node.js, and that the Enterprise team supports an edge Jetson inference pipeline.
leads.angle_reason: Roboflow's Agent and workflow products are AI features on a full-stack product, and MedVault shows an AI feature shipped end to end, from model-call pipeline to an authenticated Django API.

leads.summary: OpenCall is an AI phone and text assistant for medical practices that answers calls, books appointments into the practice's system, and runs follow-up and billing workflows for staff.
leads.hook: The site says sensitive calls hand off to human staff with the transcript, next steps and sentiment already in the sidebar.
leads.angle_reason: Both are AI products in healthcare admin: MedVault's safety-constrained LLM output and per-user data isolation map onto OpenCall's patient-facing intake and booking workflows.
